changes.comment: Remove the dead `FeishuBot.inviteMembers` pass-through and its test fakes. The method was added for the dispatcher-only `team.create_group` flow and has had no caller since that flow was retired in the #182 PR-8 cleanup; `FeishuBot` is a Dreamux-internal contract. The Feishu transport `createGroup`/`inviteMembers` wrappers and their exported types are intentionally kept.
